findings.verification: Not independently reproduced (no simulator/Xcode). Assessed from verification.md logs plus code inspection of the warning path and the retained failing assertions.

findings.evidence: noff_find_arg scans every argv token from index 1 and matches any exact "--calendar", so it returns "--location" as the calendar name; the new no-default-fallback branch then emits invalid_args "Calendar not found" and the event is not saved, even though the caller never passed --calendar. The same free-text collision class remains for --title/--notes/--location/--alarm values; only --time-zone received the position-aware parser and the test testTimeZoneOptionLikeValuesAreLiteral covers only the --time-zone literal.
findings.location: snapshot/src/ios/NativeOffloads/CalendarOffload.m calendar_cmd_create: `NSString *calName = noff_find_arg(argc, argv, "--calendar");` (~line 881) and calendar_option_has_value() positional scan in the same function; snapshot/src/ios/NativeOffloads/NativeOffloadUtils.m noff_find_arg().
findings.requirement: task.md 本轮授权后的复核 / 004 R2 fix intent: option values equal to an option literal must not be mis-read (only --time-zone was hardened); ios-calendar-recurrence.md: 指定 --calendar 后若找不到该日历会返回 invalid_args，不再静默写入默认日历.

findings.verification: Static tracing of noff_find_arg bounds (i < argc-1) and calendar_cmd_create error path; not executed at runtime.

findings.evidence: The token fails calendar_option_has_value(), fails hasPrefix:@"--recurrence", and is skipped; "weekly" is also skipped, so options is empty, parse_recurrence returns YES with rule=nil, and create saves an ordinary non-recurring event with exit 0. testInvalidRulesDoNotSave only exercises "--recurrence-typo", which preserves the prefix and is rejected. The spec text promises misspelled recurrence options return invalid_args and are not saved.
findings.location: snapshot/src/ios/NativeOffloads/CalendarOffload.m parse_recurrence(): `if (![key hasPrefix:@"--recurrence"]) continue;` and the duplicate/missing/unknown check that only runs after that prefix gate.
